recommendation: Keep the source fix. No further FHIR-core change is needed for the seed unless the work group wants a broader generated-fragment cleanup, because the normative/reference guidance already permits contained canonical references.
issue_request: FHIR-16762 was a Published/Persuasive CDS issue against the clinical reasoning module's suicide-risk order-set fragment. It reported that contained resources were not possible for canonicals, based on a fragment that used Reference-style contained syntax for a PlanDefinition action definition.
initial_application: Canonical-contained support had already been applied before the issue was marked applied: commit 2319e45e41 clarified canonical references and allowed canonical types to refer to contained resources; commit bac90582b2 converted the authoritative PlanDefinition example away from nested Reference elements; commit f91f58dcb6 updated the clinical reasoning inline fragments from nested Reference elements to unsuffixed definition values.
additional_context: The clinical reasoning topic is in build scope via source/hierarchy.xml, and PlanDefinition is active in source/fhir.ini. Later Published issue FHIR-18186 made PlanDefinition.action.definition[x] a canonical-or-uri choice; commit 72f0fdf2f4 updated authoritative PlanDefinition XML examples to definitionCanonical, but the copied inline fragments on the clinical reasoning topic page still showed the pre-choice definition value form. Current references.html and datatypes.html already explicitly permit canonical fragment references to contained resources.
reconciliation: Updated source/clinicalreasoning-knowledge-artifact-representation.html so the affected inline fragments use definitionCanonical for #referralToMentalHealthCare, #citalopramPrescription, and #procedure, matching the current StructureDefinition and authoritative PlanDefinition examples.
source_changes: source/clinicalreasoning-knowledge-artifact-representation.html: changed four escaped XML fragments from definition value to definitionCanonical value for contained ActivityDefinition targets.
